brief.audienceDescription: Students and remote workers who lose focus to their phones.
brief.angle: Calm focus beats willpower: show the real timer and blocking in action.
brief.usp: A calm Pomodoro timer that blocks distracting apps.
brief.visualDirection: Soft gradients, real iPhone screens, slow confident motion.

variants.title: The 3 a.m. scroll
variants.hook: It's 1 a.m. and you've opened Instagram 14 times since you sat down to study.
variants.keyMessage: Your phone isn't the problem; the lack of a calm boundary is.
variants.rationale: Problem-first hooks match the study-with-me finding.
variants.hypothesis: A problem-first hook earns more saves than a demo-first hook among students.

variants.title: One tap to deep work
variants.hook: Watch this: one tap and every distracting app is gone for 25 minutes.
variants.keyMessage: Tidy Timer turns focus into a single tap.
variants.hypothesis: Demo-first videos drive more profile taps.

variants.title: Why I built a calmer timer
variants.hook: I built this timer because every focus app I tried felt like a slot machine.
variants.keyMessage: A maker's honest reason for building something calmer.
variants.rationale: Founder stories build trust for a small app.
